user.title: Switch Controlled Light
user.description: Create a switch group that controls one or more lights. The virtual lights are only on when every selected switch is on; state, brightness, color and effects mirror the chosen light entities. You will add the first controlled light in the next step.

abort.already_configured: This switch controlled light is already configured.

init.title: Switch Controlled Light
init.description: Update the switches and optional auto-close timer. To delete a single controlled light, select it under "Controlled light to delete" and confirm in the next step. Deleting a light only removes that light; to remove the whole switch group, delete this integration entry instead.

delete_light.title: Delete controlled light
delete_light.description: Delete {name}? Only this controlled light is removed. The switch group and its other lights are kept.

error.delete_not_confirmed: Confirm the deletion to remove the controlled light.
error.light_not_found: The selected controlled light no longer exists.

user.title: Add controlled light
user.description: Add another light to the switch group of {name}.

reconfigure.title: Edit controlled light
reconfigure.description: Change the light controlled by the switch group of {name}.

delete.title: Delete controlled light
delete.description: Delete the controlled light {name}? Only this light is removed. The switch group and its other lights are kept.

abort.already_configured: This light is already controlled by this switch group.
